stem.text: The table shows the melting points of $\text{SiO}_2$ and $\text{P}_4\text{O}_6$.
Which statement explains the difference between the melting points of $\text{SiO}_2$ and $\text{P}_4\text{O}_6$?

A.text: The bonding of the oxides changes from ionic to covalent.

B.text: The metallic character of the elements decreases across Period 3.

C.text: The oxidation number of the element increases from Si to P.

D.text: The structure changes from giant molecular to simple molecular.
